kamloops.title: Okanagan grape growers say crop insurance model failing amid wildfire smoke taint
kamloops.description: Consecutive crop losses driven by climate change are exposing gaps in B.C.’s production insurance program, growers say.

kamloops.title: Why are B.C. firefighters still using wildfire data from the 1990s?
kamloops.description: Prolonged drought in B.C.'s Southern Interior has led to explosive wildfires that current modelling software struggles to predict. It's partly because the data that informs these computer models was collected at least 30 years ago, when extreme fire behaviour, driven by events like prolonged drought — a feature of climate change — was less common.

kamloops.title: Penticton, B.C., breaks ground on new fire hall headquarters
kamloops.description: Members of Penticton city council, the Penticton Fire Department, and the Penticton Indian Band were on hand to mark the occasion of the groundbreaking. Construction on the $38-million project is expected to be completed in two years.

southeast.title: Cranbrook mayoral candidates differ on experience, public safety and growth ahead of vote
southeast.description: Public safety, economic growth and experience are emerging as key points of contrast between the two candidates running to become Cranbrook's next mayor.
